purpose.en: Describe how an agent-relative representation of reality can be constructed and revised from observed information, prior information, memory, source/provenance cues, social context and explicit uncertainty, while keeping empirically supported effects separate from normative computation and interpretive theory.
purpose.ro: Descrie modul în care o reprezentare a realității relativă la agent poate fi construită și revizuită din informația observată, informația anterioară, memorie, indicii despre sursă/proveniență, context social și incertitudine explicită, păstrând separat efectele susținute empiric de calculul normativ și de teoria interpretativă.

scope_boundary.en: This module is not a calibrated population model, not a claim that the brain literally implements Bayes' rule, not a truth oracle and not a replacement for the existing CBD belief variable B. Its executable operator is a normative proposition-level reference update available only when a prior probability and a defensible diagnostic likelihood ratio are supplied.
scope_boundary.ro: Acest modul nu este un model calibrat populațional, nu afirmă că creierul implementează literal regula lui Bayes, nu este un oracol al adevărului și nu înlocuiește variabila CBD existentă B pentru convingere. Operatorul executabil este o actualizare normativă de referință la nivel de propoziție, disponibilă numai când sunt furnizate o probabilitate anterioară și un raport de verosimilitate diagnostic justificabil.

claims: Controlled cue-integration studies show that humans can combine uncertain sensory estimates in ways close to reliability-weighted maximum-likelihood predictions in specific tasks.
Prior knowledge and schemas can influence interpretation, encoding and retrieval, but the direction and magnitude are task- and context-dependent rather than a universal scalar coefficient.
Source monitoring and source-related evaluation affect how communicated information is attributed and used.
Repeated exposure can increase perceived truth or plausibility in some tasks; CBD already represents familiarity separately and MOD.14 does not duplicate it.
Confidence and metacognitive quality are distinct from objective accuracy; uncertainty display must not be treated as knowledge certification.
A binary proposition can be updated normatively from prior probability p and diagnostic likelihood ratio LR by posterior odds = prior odds × LR.
Binary Shannon entropy, normalized to [0,1], is used only as a transparent derived uncertainty indicator of the normative proposition state.
Sequential likelihood-ratio accumulation is permitted only when each LR is defensible and dependence between evidence items is handled by the supplying measurement model.

The world-model cycle organizes observation/selection, memory/prior retrieval, source and provenance evaluation, social-context interpretation, proposition revision, uncertainty retention and contradiction-driven reassessment.

Existing CBD variables are inputs or neighboring constructs where appropriate; no universal coefficients are assigned to attention, memory, familiarity, source reliability or social context without an empirical measurement bridge.
Predictive-coding and Bayesian-brain accounts are useful interpretive frames for uncertainty-sensitive inference but are not encoded here as a universal neural mechanism.
The phrase 'constructed reality' denotes an internal, partial, revisable representation; it does not imply that external reality is created by cognition.

variables.definition: Normative probability assigned to a binary proposition before the current diagnostic evidence item.
not_equivalent_to: population prevalence unless explicitly defined as such

variables.definition: Externally justified, strictly positive diagnostic evidence ratio P(evidence|proposition true) / P(evidence|proposition false).
variables.range_note: The numeric range is 0 < LR < infinity; the lower endpoint 0 is excluded and non-finite values are invalid.

variables.definition: Normative proposition probability after applying one or more justified likelihood-ratio updates.
Normalized binary Shannon entropy derived from Pwm; 1 at p=0.5 and 0 at p=0 or p=1.
Traceable record of the evidence item, source, acquisition context and measurement assumptions used in an update.

mechanisms.description: Only a subset of available information becomes observed/encoded. MOD.14 links to existing exposure, preview/access and observed-sample constructs rather than introducing a generic attention coefficient.

label.ro: Recuperarea informației anterioare și a memoriei

mechanisms.description: Previously stored information and schemas can constrain interpretation and retrieval. No universal numerical mapping to Pprior is asserted.
Source attribution and task-relevant source evaluation condition how communicated information is used. Existing CBD source-reliability learning remains distinct.
Communicated information is interpreted in social context, including speaker/source cues and consensus information when available. No generic conformity multiplier is introduced.
Transforms Pprior and a defensible LR into Pwm by Bayes' odds form; it is a transparent reference computation, not a descriptive law of human cognition.
Carries proposition-level normative uncertainty forward rather than collapsing the representation to true/false.
Counterevidence, corrections or source reappraisal can trigger revision. Existing CBD correction accessibility and continued-influence constructs remain the relevant neighboring mechanisms.

sequence: reassess on new or contradictory evidence
temporal_model.warning: An event step has no fixed mapping to seconds, days or years.

preconditions: LR is supplied by a defensible domain-specific diagnostic or measurement model
sequential evidence is not treated as independent unless that assumption is defensible
executable_specification.failure_mode: Fail closed: no posterior is computed when LR is absent, non-finite, non-positive or merely inferred from familiarity/source trust/social agreement.

cross_links.role: available/observed information history; does not itself determine evidence diagnosticity
existing familiarity state; empirical neighbor, never substituted for LR
existing accessibility of corrective context for contradiction/reassessment
agent-relative source estimate; not actual reliability and not automatically an LR
existing descriptive latent belief propensity; deliberately distinct from normative Pwm
existing M1 observed-information summary feeding issue representation in its own task
existing bounded M1 issue-appraisal state; task-specific neighbor, not replaced by Pwm
availability event, explicitly not proof of attention or encoding
observed access/open action; does not certify comprehension or belief

falsification_and_tests.claim: Reliability-sensitive cue integration can approximate statistically efficient weighting in controlled tasks.
falsification_and_tests.weakening_condition: Across tasks explicitly designed to estimate cue reliabilities, human integration repeatedly fails to vary with diagnostic reliability beyond measurement error and task-specific alternatives fit better.
falsification_and_tests.scope: EMPIRICAL; not a universal cognition claim

falsification_and_tests.claim: Prior knowledge/schema can alter interpretation, encoding or retrieval.
falsification_and_tests.weakening_condition: Pre-registered manipulations of relevant prior/schema information produce no reproducible differences in the specified outcome under conditions with adequate power and manipulation checks.
falsification_and_tests.scope: EMPIRICAL; directional sign must be specified per task

falsification_and_tests.claim: Provenance/source information can influence attribution and communicated-information evaluation.
falsification_and_tests.weakening_condition: Controlled source/provenance manipulations produce no reproducible differences in attribution or evaluation under task conditions where source information is available and attended.

falsification_and_tests.claim: The Bayes operator correctly implements the declared normative update.
falsification_and_tests.weakening_condition: Software output differs from the algebraic odds-form update or violates probability/entropy invariants.
falsification_and_tests.scope: EXECUTABLE software correctness, not empirical falsification of human cognition

limitations: Pwm is a proposition-level normative reference value, not an estimate of a person's latent belief B.
Binary proposition representation is deliberately narrow and does not capture rich relational, causal or continuous world models.
Likelihood ratios must come from external domain-specific measurement models; MOD.14 does not manufacture them from psychological cues.
Evidence dependence can cause severe double counting if likelihood ratios are multiplied naively.
Entropy captures uncertainty of a binary normative probability only; it does not include model misspecification, unknown unknowns or social disagreement.
Predictive coding, free-energy and Bayesian-brain theories remain interpretive framing unless a task-specific empirical bridge is supplied.
No population calibration, human recruitment, Pencode estimation or M1.E4 reactivation is introduced. Phase M remains unchanged.
